summary: Pend Oreille County, WA 20-ft pole L-4 lookout, built 1931 and removed or destroyed in the 1960s; no standing tower; 2023 notes describe footings and a passable road.

facts.design: 20-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab; patrol points about 1/2 mile south (platform tower) and 2 miles north (Mosquito Point)
facts.status_note: Removed in the 1960s per the register (Rex's page says only removed, with no date); destroyed in the 1960s per firelookout.com and WillhiteWeb

access.note: On Kaniksu/Colville National Forest land; WillhiteWeb describes road and hike access in 2023 and no closure

visit.trail_note: Old one-mile spur road to the summit, overgrown but still passable in 2023 per WillhiteWeb; about 500 feet of gain

events.note: 20-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab; register and WillhiteWeb agree on the year
Forest Service surveyed a six-mile road from Bead Lake Pass to the lookout; an August 27, 1941 newspaper quote on Rex's page says it may be built that year
Sometime in the 1960s; the register says removed in the 1960s, Rex's page says removed with no date, firelookout.com and WillhiteWeb say destroyed
Registered November 23, 2012 as US 1483, WA 383; nominated by Ray Kresek

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the lookout was removed in the 1960s, and Rex's page says only that it was removed, with no date. firelookout.com and WillhiteWeb say it was destroyed in that decade. All four agree it was gone by then. The story reports both words and does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: The register, firelookout.com, WillhiteWeb and Rex's page are the only sources; the 1941 road survey comes from a newspaper quote reproduced on Rex's page and from WillhiteWeb. The register and Rex's page say removed (only the register dates it to the 1960s) while firelookout.com and WillhiteWeb say destroyed; both are kept. The 2023 condition is from one hobby site (WillhiteWeb) and its photo captions do not say exactly where the footings are. The brief's record checks out: county, forest, registration date and FFLOS number match. No corrections proposed.
